What to look for: the compile below is clean, with zero warnings. That is
the finding, not a reassurance. AOPayload.ddxRay and AOPayload.ddyRay are
qualified write(caller) and are never assigned anywhere in this file, in
RaygenShader or otherwise. TraceRay is invoked only through the
TraceRadianceRay helper, one call away from raygen. Compare this pane
against tools/clang/test/HLSLFileCheck/hlsl/payload_qualifier/nested_access.hlsl
TEST_NUM=5, whose direct-in-raygen TraceRay call does get the
"field is never written for TraceRay call" diagnostic for an equivalent
violation. This is not the false-positive #5848 reports; it is the
opposite defect found while trying to reconstruct that report -- see
notes.md for the source-level explanation (raygeneration shaders carry a
null Info.Payload, which gates off the recursive check entirely for any
TraceRay call reached through a helper function).
